property_summary: After Alice deposits 2 ether into C, calling SetMinSum(1 ether) and Initialized(), a Collect(1 ether) call from Alice succeeds on reference (balance reduced, Log added) but the buggy version (missing Log.AddMessage on Deposit) still allows Collect to succeed because the bug only affects log recording, not state; however the assertion that c.balances(Alice) after Collect is 1 ether holds for both, but the divergence observable is that Log.History length is 1 for reference and 0 for buggy version.
